answer: Use a micro-batch job with a 10-second trigger that reads the existing order event log, not a record-at-a-time stream. The screen's SLA is about 1 minute, since staff glance about once a minute, so a 10 s trigger keeps p99 well under it, while a 1 minute trigger would push the worst case past the minute staff act on. Micro-batch runs on the batch scheduler and cluster the team already operates, with the same code and on-call rotation. Nobody is on call overnight, and a record-at-a-time engine would add a second runtime to operate and page on. A failed cycle reruns whole, which is acceptable here.
